description: SDM Cross Table Charts builds a full hierarchical cross-tabulation, then replaces the plain numeric cells with small diverging charts drawn inside each cell — a data bar or a sparkline-style connected line. Think spreadsheet conditional-formatting bars, but hierarchical, statistically aware and fully stylable. Key features: Data Bar: a diverging bar per cell, split at a zero axis and scaled against a single table-wide axis so every bar stays comparable Data Line: one point per cell connected into a trend, running down rows or across columns, with configurable markers and thickness Gap Mode: collapse a whole column group into 1–3 synthetic gap columns — main partition versus the group average, or versus two named competitors Four chart value modes: Cell Value, Compare to Regex, or follow the gap captured by significance test 1, 2 or 3 Significance overlays: significant cells decorate the chart with a coloured fill, gradient, marker shape or custom icon instead of a lettered cell Colours and gradients: independent positive, negative and neutral colours, optional gradient tip and 1px bar border Zero axis styles: none, line, double, dotted, dashed, or a drafting-style axis line Grouping: merge the last hierarchical level of rows or columns into one clustered chart per cell, with an automatic colour legend Full crosstab engine: percentage and mean tables, Value / Vertical % /…
